title: Pure Appliancer
summary: Appliancer cards only, with generic Links and staples. Appliancer is a Link-1 Machine swarm built on co-linking: most Appliancer Links gain a stronger effect when another Link points at them. Appliancer Socketroll summons itself and pulls more copies from the Deck. Appliancer Copybokkle summons itself as a copy of another Appliancer and later brings a same-named one back. Appliancer Electrilyrical World searches an Appliancer card and recovers a monster after each Appliancer Link Summon. Appliancer Vacculephant destroys a card, Laundry Dragon banishes what it battles, and Kappa Scale revives a Link. Appliancer Celtopus can't be targeted while linked and pumps co-linked Links. Appliancer Conversion, the newest card, banishes your Appliancer Links and summons them again to reset their effects. The Main Deck is thin, so most of it is generic staples.
